samplingProtocol: Opportunistic photography by visiting researchers and students
locality: The Wilds Conservation Center, Muskingum County, Ohio, USA
datasetName: The Wilds 2025 Multi-Modal Survey - Citizen Science
fieldNotes: Raw-folder inventory: 1,103 media files (965 still images and 138 videos). Manual annotations cover 791 photos; curation retained 564 wildlife photos (excluded 137 with humans, 77 equipment-only, and 225 without species; categories overlap). Multi-taxon photos yield 622 Darwin Core Occurrences across 13 observation sessions. Fifty curated Sep. 8 photos are sourced from the Google Photos album export rather than the photos_videos folder; their media references state that source explicitly. 20 species identified via manual annotation.
